name: Document Loader: MDXEditor
description: Adds a "Load Document" button to the MDXEditor toolbar.
project_description: Document Loader: MDXEditor adds a "Load Document" button to the AI module's MDXEditor toolbar. Clicking it opens a modal dialog that discovers available Document Loader source categories, lets the editor pick a source (media-library file, website, API, etc.), loads and converts the document to markdown through the Document Loader pipeline, sanitizes the result for MDXEditor, and inserts it into the editor's underlying textarea. It requires the AI module (1.4+) providing the MDXEditor, plus the Document Loader media-library opener submodule.
